svg.title: Yeony — Small ideas. Useful possibilities.
svg.desc: Yeony creative tools. A thick, beveled Möbius belt shown at an angle that reveals its half-twist, with a smooth silhouette and continuous lighting over its complete material circulating through the fixed twist. Brushed grain, transverse joints, edge stitches and six alternating single-surface yellow inlays move together. One geometric lap takes 8.4 seconds and the complete surface circuit takes 16.8 seconds. Six short face-normal markers rotate around all three local axes: negative X, positive Y, and negative Z. The Z rotation follows the original clockwise orbit in the reference front view. Each axis completes a revolution in 30 seconds.

g.aria-label: A smooth, thick Möbius belt. Its complete material and six yellow inlays circulate through the fixed twist under continuous lighting, without visible polygon seams.
